title: vdb~
description: `vdb~` treats a Pd array as a delay line with internal feedback, exposing the delay-line contents in the array. It supports fixed or changing delay times, and its arguments specify the buffer name, maximum delay time in milliseconds, delay time, feedback, and channel. For infinite hold, `inf_hold` can be toggled and `fadein`/`fadeout` can soften clicks at array boundaries.
